epics.title: Production RMM milestone
epics.body: Forward plan item 3 in `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` as updated on the PR #54 branch: eight small PRs in dependency order, all on `internal/remote`, the signed agent protocol, the command pipeline and device trust; no second backend or execution path. Privileged commands stay blocked until PR 2 (K-2) lands.

epics.title: Identity follow-ups
epics.body: Still open from forward plan items 1 and 2 in `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` (device identity and agent identity).

tickets.title: PR 2: Security hardening and privileged execution architecture
tickets.body:
HTTPS enforcement for privileged agents, per-command operator approval the agent can verify, device-level scopes, trusted-device policy check, separate privileged helper (Windows service as LocalSystem / root systemd unit) reachable only over a local authenticated channel, output redaction and transcript retention.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Every prerequisite listed under forward plan item 3 exists and is tested
- [ ] Agents refuse privileged work over plain HTTP or without a verifiable approval
- [ ] Decision record for the privileged helper and its local channel
- [ ] Security review of the change

tickets.title: PR 3: System-management commands
tickets.body:
Service restart/stop, process termination, reboot/shutdown, log retrieval, detailed hardware/network inventory, each with permission, validation, confirmation and audit.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Each command has its own permission, input validation, operator confirmation and audit entry
- [ ] Runs only through the privileged helper from K-2 on trusted devices
- [ ] Integration tests for success, denial and failure

tickets.title: PR 4: RMM device page
tickets.body:
Overview, system, performance, processes, services, software, actions, command history, agent status, audit; loading/offline/denied/failed states.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] All sections show observed data with provenance; no demo data
- [ ] Loading, offline, denied and failed states for each section
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`; checked in a browser at desktop and narrow widths

tickets.title: PR 5: Bounded non-interactive remote commands
tickets.body:
PowerShell and shell commands with timeouts, cancellation, polled output and protected transcripts.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Hard limits on runtime and output size; cancellation reaches the process
- [ ] Transcripts follow the retention and redaction rules from K-2
- [ ] Audited end to end; integration tests

tickets.title: PR 6: File management in authorized roots
tickets.body:
Browse, upload, download in explicitly authorized roots with size limits, traversal protection and integrity checks.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Roots configured per device or group; anything outside is refused
- [ ] Traversal, symlink and size-limit tests
- [ ] Integrity check on transfer; audited

tickets.title: PR 7: Signed agent releases and remote updates
tickets.body:
Versioned, signed agent releases and authorized remote updates with verification and rollback. Starts versioning and tagging (forward plan item 9).

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Release signing and verification in the agent before an update is applied
- [ ] Authorized, audited update command with rollback on failure
- [ ] Versioning and changelog started

tickets.title: PR 8: Documentation and end-to-end verification on real hosts
tickets.body:
Documentation and end-to-end verification on real Windows and Linux hosts.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] REMOTE_MANAGEMENT.md and AGENT_SETUP.md describe the shipped behaviour
- [ ] Verified on a real elevated Windows host and a real Linux host, including service installation
- [ ] IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md updated

tickets.title: Move the discovery worker and traffic sensor onto enrolled identities
tickets.body:
The discovery worker uses the shared `NERVE_DISCOVERY_AGENT_TOKEN` and the traffic sensor the shared `NERVE_SENSOR_TOKEN`; management agents already use per-agent Ed25519 keys.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Discovery and sensor reports authenticated by enrolled identities
- [ ] Migration path for existing installations; shared tokens removed or deprecated
- [ ] Integration tests; docs updated

tickets.title: Agent and Core key rotation
tickets.body:
Agent-initiated key rotation and Core key rotation without re-enrollment.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Agents rotate their key through a signed, audited exchange
- [ ] Core signing key rotates while enrolled agents keep working
- [ ] Integration tests; REMOTE_MANAGEMENT.md updated

tickets.title: Vendor (OUI) lookup and automatic device classification
tickets.body:
Device identity follow-up. Observed MAC addresses must never be sent to third parties, so the lookup data is local.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Offline OUI data source with licence and update process
- [ ] Classification stored as a sourced fact with confidence, never overriding operator-owned fields
- [ ] Tests

tickets.title: Multi-address device matching in the Traffic Map
tickets.body:
The Traffic Map still correlates devices by one primary address.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Flows match a device by any current address
- [ ] `npm run test:map` covers the multi-address case

tickets.title: PR 1: Agent service installation and lifecycle
tickets.body:
Agent as Windows service / systemd unit with unprivileged accounts, installers, persistent config, private-CA TLS, diagnostics, run state and graceful-stop reporting (`connection`: online/stopped/offline), live re-enrollment.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] `nerve-agent service install|uninstall|start|stop|restart|status` on Windows and Linux
- [x] Installers, `config.json`, `diagnose`, migration `000010_agent_runtime`
- [x] Go unit and integration tests, Windows-native agent tests, Linux systemd end-to-end run
- [ ] Windows service installation executed on a real elevated host (not verified in the PR)

Implemented in PR #54 (`feat/agent-service-lifecycle`).
